scope: Additive vocabulary for bounded captured-source roles. Each record's cited rationale governs its meaning; labels do not establish current usage, lifecycle, authority, backup provenance or operational acceptance.

role_taxonomy.compatibility_declaration: Retains a procedure signature with no executable body in the captured source; no caller compatibility or invocation is established.
role_taxonomy.paired_structural_record: Has columns compared with a separately identified record shape; pairing does not establish a copy, archive or retention process.
role_taxonomy.structural_copy: Has a matching captured column shape; the label does not establish copying provenance, timing, contents or use.
role_taxonomy.activity_measurement: Provides fields for activity quantities, intervals or costs; formulas, units and actual measured events require separate evidence.
role_taxonomy.request_record: Provides an identified request record and associated fields; processing, payload grammar and retry behavior remain unestablished.
role_taxonomy.authorization_metadata: Represents access associations or permission metadata; actual authorization enforcement is not established by the schema.
role_taxonomy.annotation_data: Stores comments or annotations associated with identifiers; generic identifiers do not establish validated business-object relationships.
role_taxonomy.configuration_payload: Represents configuration-shaped values; their effective use, precedence and execution are not established.
role_taxonomy.staging_payload: Provides an intermediate payload shape; a conversion, import or production-consumer lifecycle requires separate evidence.
role_taxonomy.master_data: Provides reusable entity identities and descriptive fields; current authority, inheritance and consumer behavior require separate evidence.
role_taxonomy.document_metadata: Stores document references or related status fields; document existence, accessibility and upload completion are not established.
role_taxonomy.payload_shape: Provides a structurally described payload without sufficient evidence of a producer, consumer or authoritative operational role.
role_taxonomy.retained_record_shape: Provides a record shape with historical or deleted-state associations; names and fields do not prove events, retention completeness or recoverability.
role_taxonomy.message_payload: Provides message content and related status fields; transmission, acknowledgment, retry and delivery guarantees are not established.
role_taxonomy.request_state: Stores request identity, status or timestamps; stored values do not establish processor behavior or physical outcomes.
role_taxonomy.activity_history: Provides activity record fields; completeness, chronology, duration calculations and actual completed work remain unestablished.
role_taxonomy.content_storage: Stores text or content segments; reconstruction, ordering, encoding and completeness require caller evidence.
role_taxonomy.configuration_state: Provides state used to represent settings or counters; effective values, atomic changes and validation require separate evidence.
role_taxonomy.version_metadata: Stores version or patch provenance fields; this does not establish the installed version of every component.
role_taxonomy.measurement_storage: Provides instrumentation measurement fields; observed values, instrumentation boundaries and whole-process timing are not established.
role_taxonomy.authorization_payload_shape: Provides an authorization-shaped payload without established active use or enforcement.
role_taxonomy.integrity_metadata: Stores hash or integrity-related fields; algorithms, trusted provenance and verification enforcement require separate evidence.
role_taxonomy.metadata_workspace_shape: Provides a metadata-oriented record shape; temporary names do not establish session scope, consumers or cleanup behavior.
role_taxonomy.association_payload_shape: Provides identifiers that can represent associations; valid relationships and operational effects require separate evidence.
role_taxonomy.interface_payload: Provides interface-oriented fields; transport direction, processing, delivery and acknowledgment remain separate claims.
role_taxonomy.activity_state: Stores activity-related state such as timestamps; current presence, authentication and attendance are not established.
role_taxonomy.identity_metadata: Stores user or identity-related attributes; authentication mechanisms and effective privileges require separate evidence.
